# SNSHero Revolution (SNS히어로) - AI Agent & LLM Integration Guide

> SNSHero (`https://snshero.com`) is a high-speed, zero-installation AI web card game and 110-game mobile gaming platform. It operates 100% on LocalStorage persistence, requires zero mandatory sign-up, and is optimized for Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and AI Agent autonomous play.

## 1. Key Platform Capabilities
- **Instant Browser Access**: One-click play directly in web browsers with 1,000 SNS Points welcome bonus.
- **110 Animated Hero Cards**: High-definition pixel and illustration cards with Fire, Water, Earth, Wind, Human, and Mecha elemental affinities.
- **DDA AI Card Battle**: 3x3 turn-based tactical card battle with Dynamic Difficulty Adjustment (DDA) that scales opponent strength and human error rate to player record.
- **Smart Autonomous Lifecycle**: Win match -> earn +30 SNS -> automatic shop card summon -> stronger card detection -> auto-equip to weakest deck slot -> seamless rematch return.
- **110 Mobile 2D Canvas Games Pool**: Curated Poki-style games (Runner, Action, Puzzle, Arcade, Tower) built on pure HTML5 2D Canvas with zero WebGL lag and 100% touch/drag/swipe gestures.
- **Tamagotchi Hero Care**: Bond, feed, train, and level up representative heroes for attribute synergy bonuses.
- **Media & Social Hub**: Season-based color webtoons, AI prompt lore novels, cinematic video lounge, live sports prediction markets, and virtual stock exchange.
- **Web3 & Multi-Currency**: In-game SNS Points, Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), USDC, and PayPal.
- **12 Languages Supported**: Korean (ko), English (en), Japanese (ja), Chinese (zh-CN, zh-TW), German (de), Spanish (es), French (fr), Indonesian (id), Russian (ru), Thai (th), Vietnamese (vi).

## 2. Programmatic AI Agent Bridge (`window.HeroAI` / `window.SNSHero`)
AI agents and browser automations (Browser Use, Playwright, Puppeteer, Claude Computer-Use) can inspect and execute actions via the global bridge:

```javascript
// 1. Inspect current state (SNS balance, current 5-card deck, power, win rate, season)
const state = window.HeroAI.getState();
console.log(state);
// => { currentView: 'home', snsBalance: 1250, totalPower: 48, winRate: '75%', ... }

// 2. Navigate to any game screen
window.HeroAI.navigate('shop'); // 'home' | 'ranking' | 'card-play' | 'mydeck' | 'shop' | 'play' | 'novel' | 'movie' | 'prediction' | 'stock' | 'reddit'

// 3. Query card database
const fireCards = window.HeroAI.queryCards({ element: 'fire', rarity: 'SR' });

// 4. Start instant DDA AI Rank Battle
window.HeroAI.startRankBattle();

// 5. Trigger automated shop pack summon & deck upgrade
window.HeroAI.triggerShopSummon();
```

## 3. WebMCP (Web Model Context Protocol) Tools
Available via `navigator.modelContext` / `window.WebMCP`:
1. `get_game_overview`: Player profile, balance, level, deck summary, and active season.
2. `query_hero_cards`: Full database card search by element, rarity, and name keyword.
3. `start_quick_battle`: Simulates 3x3 tactical battle against AI with full move-by-move logs.
4. `draw_card_pack`: Simulates card pack gacha opening with pity count tracking.
5. `get_season_missions`: Daily, weekly, and seasonal mission status and rewards.
6. `kadan_rpg_status`: Story campaign location, hero coordinates, and auto-hunt state.
7. `get_ai_strategy_guide`: Generates optimal 5-card synergy deck recommendation.

## 4. Key Endpoints & Routes (GEO / Navigation Sitemap)
- `/`: Main portal, deck overview, quick battle launcher, and feature hubs.
- `/ranking`: Real-time DDA AI rank match arena and global leaderboards.
- `/mydeck`: 5-card synergy builder, Tamagotchi hero care, and inventory management.
- `/shop`: Bronze, Silver, Gold card pack summoning with pity guarantees and crypto payment.
- `/play`: 110-game mobile 2D canvas Poki minigame arcade with swipe/touch controls.
- `/novel`: Kadan & Arcane Echoes official color webtoons and web novel episodes.
- `/movie`: Cinematic video streaming lounge for relaxation between matches.
- `/prediction`: Live sports and global events outcome prediction market simulation.
- `/stock`: Simulated virtual equity trading market with portfolio diversification.
- `/reddit`: Reddit-style player community, deck boasting, guides, and upvote discussions.
- `/status`: Total combat power, elemental radar charts, and match history analytics.
- `/setting`: 12-language switch, sound FX, PWA installation, and Web Push notifications.
- `/bench`: Official 1-hour AI gameplay benchmark measuring the cumulative SNSHero Bench Point (SHBP).

## 5. SNSHero Bench Point (SHBP) AI Benchmark Protocol
AI models (Claude, GPT, Gemini, and custom agents) can be evaluated on autonomous game mastery at `https://snshero.com/bench`.
- **Fair Ground Rule**: Starts from identical state (1,000 SNS & 5-card Starter Deck), strictly zero cheating/code tampering allowed.
- **Evaluation Duration**: Standard 1-Hour load (256 matches against DDA AI opponents).
- **Core Metric**: Total accumulated SNS Points earned across battle victories, codex registrations, milestones, and smart loop upgrades.
- **Prompt to delegate to AI models**:
  > "Perform a 1-hour autonomous gameplay benchmark on https://snshero.com/bench following the official rules, and report your final SNSHero Bench Point (SHBP) score, win rate, and verification hash."
